explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain exactly why the objective increases from 175.37 to 297.04 by tracing the code changes that implement the low-emission-zone policy. Your answer must name the new decision variable and constant term added to the objective (`y[i]` and `z_force`), identify the exact CSV columns and parameter that drive them (`Outsource_Cost`, `Mandatory_External`, `inhouse_truck_limit=3`), and connect them to the business document statement that customers 12 and 16 must be removed from in-house routing. Then, using the LP-relaxation diagnostics, discuss which revised truck-limit constraint(s) are likely binding, what their shadow prices/slacks mean in business terms, and why you cannot linearly extrapolate that marginal value to predict the effect of allowing a 4th in-house truck in the integer model.
